46525.summary: The class explores the first two seals of Revelation, focusing on the rapid spread of Christianity during a period of relative peace in the Roman Empire from AD 96 to 183. It emphasizes the spiritual warfare and perseverance of early Christians despite persecution, highlighting the importance of faith and readiness for future trials.

46526.summary: The class examines the third and fourth seals of Revelation, focusing on the period of Roman oppression and the suffering of the common people. It discusses the symbolism of the black horse and the rider, representing famine, taxation, and injustice, and draws parallels to contemporary issues of political and economic distress.
